what: The section stays fixed on screen while a photo strip flows left (scrolling for the strip’s length), and the cover layer (the real photo) is peeled back as far as the part past the center vertical line, revealing the layer beneath (thermal image) — a scanner where the picture stays in place and only the boundary passes through

options.line: Vertical line position (ratio of panel width), default .5

use: …
note: The cover’s first child moves opposite to the cover, so put the graphic in that single first child. The vertical line is just a marker shown when present — its position is set by the line option.
